lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately four horizontal rows of circular high-luminance clusters are visible along the mid-lateral flank, with the most prominent centroids arranged in a regular sequence posterior to the branchial slits.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs, creating a discernible grid-like arrangement of anchor nodes across the visible lateral surface.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: At least three distinct longitudinal ridges are visible running horizontally along the upper flank, characterized by a sharp vertical luminance gradient with higher intensity on the dorsal side and localized shadowing on the ventral side.

other_distinctive_markers: A sharp transition in patterning is observed between the head and flank regions, where the cephalic area displays a significantly higher density of smaller, punctate high-luminance spots compared to the larger, more widely spaced blobs on the posterior flank.
